abort.already_configured: This BLANCO device is already configured.
abort.reauth_successful: BLANCO cloud access was restored successfully.

error.access_not_granted: Access was not granted. Activate Smart Home/RCA in the BLANCO UNIT app while you are near the device, then try again within five minutes.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the BLANCO Smart Home API.
error.device_type_not_supported: BLANCO does not currently enable this device type for Smart Home access.
error.invalid_auth: The serial number or service code is invalid.

reauth_confirm.description: Activate Smart Home/RCA again in the BLANCO UNIT app while you are near the device. Continue within five minutes to restore access.
reauth_confirm.title: Restore BLANCO cloud access

data_description.serial: The serial number on the device label. Leading zeroes are significant.
data_description.service_code: Shown in BLANCO UNIT under device settings → Smart Home. It is used once and is not stored.

user.description: In BLANCO UNIT, open the device settings and activate Smart Home/RCA while you are within Bluetooth range. Then enter the serial number and service code within five minutes.
user.title: Connect a BLANCO water system

authentication_failed.message: BLANCO cloud authentication failed. Activate Smart Home/RCA in BLANCO UNIT and reauthenticate the integration.

update_failed.message: No BLANCO device endpoint could be updated.
